Name: Please Fix Error
Author: JessebotX
Description:
[b]Spams FAKE errors in your console to make you cry. Note that these errors are FAKE and will not actually break your game (unless your game is already broken)[/b]

This mod is called [u]game[/u] in the smapi console.

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
[list][*]Spam fake errors in your console every so often to make you cry
[*]Fabricate fake errors from other mods you have install to confuse you and continue to make you cry
[/list][b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]
Start playing on one of your farms and a fake error will be sent every so often (random (every 1 - 30 ticks))

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[u]Dependencies[/u]
[list][*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b](REQUIRED)[/b] - The Stardew Valley Mod Loader
[/list][u]Install[/u][list][*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and extract/unzip into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder[/url]
[/list]need help?: Check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Player's Guide to Installing and Using Mods[/url]

[u]Uninstall[/u]
Delete the folder [font=Courier New]Please Fix Error[/font] from your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[u]Platforms[/u]
[list][*][color=#ffff00]Windows ✓[/color]
[*][color=#ffff00]Mac ✓[/color]
[*][color=#ffff00]Linux ✓[/color]
[*]Android [b]?[/b] - not tested
[/list]Works in singleplayer/multiplayer (local changes; only those who have the mod install will have changes to their SMAPI log
